Phase 17 owns no provider registration row: it activates no provider, and the 39 legacy rows the census assigns are the loadable module Phase 16 owns (D525). Nothing here is a parity claim: a published command body or a passing handshake is at most `IMPLEMENTED` in docs/PARITY_MODEL.md terms, and docs/PHASE-17-SUBPHASES.md section 4 decides when the stratum may be called complete.
